name: session_search
description: session_search must scan state/sessions for a substring and return ok:true with a hits array (or ok:false with a typed min-length error) without depending on any session existing. The prompt asks for a query that is guaranteed to be at least 3 characters, so the only environment-independent assertion is the shape: ok:true and a hits array, or the too-short error when that path is taken. Goes red when the fs_prefixes policy or the search wiring breaks; stays green on empty state/sessions.
prompt: Use the session_search tool with input {"q": "the"}. Look at the tool's JSON result. If its ok field is true and it has a hits array (even if empty), reply with exactly SHAPE_OK. If its ok field is false and the error mentions the minimum length, reply with exactly SHAPE_OK. Otherwise reply with exactly SHAPE_BAD.
